thread:
Kevin: CI red on h100-prober shard 42. kernel timeout during cuda probe step, XID 79. failing since the driver rollout this morning. logs: ```2024-09-01T12:34:56Z h100-01 kernel timeout: XID 79 nvmlReset; probe step: cudartInit -> timed out after 120s``` link: https://ci.internal/reports/1723
Anya: ugh. is this the same failure as the earlier warmup flake? any visible driver version skew across pool?
ci-bot: job 1723 (h100-prober) failed on shard 42. nodes affected: h100-01,h100-03. CUDA 12.2, driver reported: 535.54 on h100-01, 534.89 on h100-03. (see artifact: /artifacts/1723/logs)
Sam: if nodes report different driver builds that's a red flag. can someone paste `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` from both nodes?
Leo: grabbed h100-01: ```NVRM version: NVIDIA UNIX x86_64 Kernel Module  535.54  Wed Aug 28 11:02:00 PDT 2024; CUDA Version: 12.2``` h100-03 looks like older: ```NVRM version: ... 534.89  Tue Aug 20 09:10:00 PDT 2024```
Anya: yep, driver skew. that explains kernel timeout on probe when the runtime expects 535 APIs. quick triage: can we rerun just shard 42 pinned to 534.89 and also rerun pinned to 535.54 to compare behavior?
Kevin: scheduling two reruns now: `rerun-ci --job 1723 --shard 42 --driver-pin 534.89` (queued), and `--driver-pin 535.54` (queued on canary infra). I'll disable the heavy warmup step for the pinned runs to avoid long hold.
Sam: capture dmesg and nv-hostengine logs if it flakes again: `dmesg | tail -n 200` and `/var/log/nv-hostengine.log`.
Leo: running the 534.89 rerun now. pinging @oncall-sre in case we need to isolate the node.
oncall-sre: noted. I'll check cluster controller for any concurrent driver rollouts and pause any remaining canaries until triage completes.
ci-bot: rerun (1723-rerun-53489) started on h100-03; rerun (1723-rerun-53554) started on h100-01-canary.
Anya: if 534.89 run passes and 535.54 fails, we should roll back the 535 rollout and open a bisect ticket to find the kernel/driver combo regression. Sam, can you own the bisect?
Sam: will take bisect. I'll start with a narrow range between 534.80..535.60. posting steps in the bisect issue once rerun artifacts are in.
Kevin: both reruns finished: 534.89 -> PASS, 535.54 -> FAIL (same XID 79). artifacts: /artifacts/1723/reruns/53489 and /53554.
Anya: ok that's actionable. create a prioritised issue, include logs, dmesg, kernel versions, and mark severity P1 for CI reliability. also add a checklist: rollback preflight, bake window, bisect owner.
Leo: I'll attach node repro instructions and a small repro harness to the issue: `python tools/probe_repro.py --node h100-01 --stress 60s`.
Sam: starting bisect now. ETA ~2 hours for initial narrow pass.
Kevin: thanks all. if anything shows broader impact we'll move to incidents/. otherwise we'll track on this thread and the bisect issue.
oncall-sre: if you see more than 3 failing nodes open incidents and I'll escalate with infra to pause rollout. good catch everyone :thumbsup:
